findings.summary: Same-connection reauthorization does not prove or preserve cursors beyond the fixed 1,000-channel read.
findings.details: S04-T02 requires same-connection reauthorization to preserve every channel key/cursor while incrementing the credentials generation. commitReconcileChannels only reads sourceChannels with take(1_000) before promoteReauthorizedChannelRows and before patching channelSyncStates for promoted rows. A Slack workspace with more than 1,000 previously discovered channels can therefore advance providerConnections to the new generation while leaving later old-generation sourceChannels and their lane cursors stale. The focused test for partial-page reauthorization uses only two channels, so the passed gate is false-green for the all-rows cursor preservation invariant.
